questions.q: Which European country ruled Macau until 1999?
questions.why: It was handed back to China on 20 December 1999.

questions.q: What is Macau's currency?
questions.why: Hong Kong dollars are also widely used.

questions.q: Which industry makes Macau one of the richest places in the world?
questions.why: Its casinos earn more than Las Vegas.

questions.q: Which two languages are official in Macau?
questions.why: Cantonese is the most spoken.

questions.q: When did the Portuguese first settle in Macau?
questions.why: It was the first and last European colony in China.

questions.q: What is Macau's status within China?
questions.why: It has its own laws.

questions.q: Which ruins of a church facade are Macau's symbol?
questions.why: The church burned in 1835.

questions.q: Which goddess temple gave Macau its name?
questions.why: Sailors named the place after her.

questions.q: Which gambling tycoon held Macau's casino monopoly for decades?
questions.why: His company held it until 2002.

questions.q: Which Macau historic centre is a UNESCO site?
questions.why: It was listed in 2005.

questions.q: Which fortress houses a lighthouse that was China's first modern one?
questions.why: The lighthouse dates from 1865.

questions.q: Which 1987 agreement arranged Macau's handover?
questions.why: It was signed in Beijing.

questions.q: Which Portuguese poet is said to have written part of 'The Lusiads' in Macau?
questions.why: A grotto there is named after him.

questions.q: Which island areas were joined by reclaimed land to form Cotai?
questions.why: It is now the casino strip.

questions.q: Which mixed Portuguese-Chinese people are native to Macau?
questions.why: Their cuisine is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which motor race runs through Macau's streets each November?
questions.why: It began in 1954.

questions.q: Which crumbly egg tart is Macau's famous snack?
questions.why: Lord Stow's Bakery made it famous.

questions.q: Which tall tower offers a famous bungee jump?
questions.why: The jump is 233 m.

questions.q: Which casino strip is built on reclaimed land?
questions.why: The Venetian Macao is there.

questions.q: Which huge casino resort in Macau copies a famous Italian city?
questions.why: It has indoor canals with gondolas.

questions.q: Which square with wavy tiled paving is in central Macau?
questions.why: The tiles are Portuguese calçada.

questions.q: Which bridge links Macau with Hong Kong?
questions.why: It opened in 2018.

questions.q: Which bread roll with a fried pork chop is a Macau snack?
questions.why: Tai Lei Loi Kei on Taipa is famous for it.

questions.q: Which almond biscuits are a popular gift from Macau?
questions.why: Shops on Rua do Cupido sell them.

questions.q: Which village on Coloane has a famous chapel and bakery?
questions.why: Lord Stow's first bakery is there.

questions.q: Which casino has a lotus-shaped golden tower?
questions.why: It opened in 2007.

questions.q: Which race is part of the Macau Grand Prix weekend?
questions.why: Ayrton Senna won it in 1983.

questions.q: What is the Macanese dish of minced meat and potato called?
questions.why: It is often topped with a fried egg.

questions.q: Which hill fort is home to the Macau Museum?
questions.why: It fought off the Dutch in 1622.

questions.q: Which 1622 attack did Macau repel?
questions.why: 24 June was long a holiday.
